headline_item.title_zh: 做空机构指控AMD涉嫌违规对华供应固件
headline_item.title_en: AMD Slides After Hunterbrook Shorts Stock, Cites Circular Deals
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 做空机构Hunterbrook指控AMD向被美列入黑名单的中国服务器厂商IEIT供应固件，引发AMD股价大幅下挫
headline_item.event_summary_en: Short-selling firm Hunterbrook alleged that AMD continued providing BIOS firmware updates to IEIT Systems, a Chinese server manufacturer blacklisted by the U.S. in March 2025. While the report stopped short of proving a legal violation, the allegation triggered market concerns over AMD's supply chain traceability and compliance efficacy, causing an 8% drop in its share price.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Advanced Micro Devices (AMD)、做空机构Hunterbrook、中国服务器厂商IEIT Systems：AMD被指在IEIT Systems进入黑名单后仍提供固件支持，引发合规性调查担忧
【起因与机理】针对高端芯片及其组件在华流通的合规性审查日益严苛
【关键数据与实测】尽管该报告承认尚未确认AMD存在实质性法律违规，但市场对AMD在复杂合规环境下的供应链溯源与管控能力产生强烈质疑，导致其股价单日跌幅一度达到8%。
【各方立场与态度】市场担忧该事件将引发监管部门对AMD供应链协同与审核机制的进一步审查。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Advanced Micro Devices (AMD), Hunterbrook, IEIT Systems: Allegations of continued firmware support for a blacklisted entity, triggering market sell-off
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Heightened scrutiny regarding high-end chip component flow to restricted entities

[Key Metrics] While the report stopped short of proving a legal violation, the allegation triggered market concerns over AMD's supply chain traceability and compliance efficacy, causing an 8% drop in its share price.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Market sentiment reflects concern over potential future regulatory probes into AMD's supply chain compliance.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 此次事件暴露了芯片厂商在下游硬件生态管理中的合规真空，即固件更新作为一种非实物交付，极易避开传统的进出口海关监管。长期来看，监管层将迫使厂商建立更细粒度的芯片全生命周期数字化管理体系，凡是支持禁运设备运行的软件分发渠道都将面临被强制切断的合规风险。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: This incident highlights a compliance vacuum in chipmakers' downstream ecosystem management, where firmware updates—as non-physical deliverables—bypass traditional customs checkpoints. Moving forward, regulators will likely mandate granular, full-lifecycle digital management for chips, placing any software distribution channels that sustain blacklisted hardware under immediate threat of enforcement.

celebrity.author: Aravind Srinivas
celebrity.quote_zh: 分享关于困惑计算机中自我提高技能的新研究。 Brain 已经维护了一个关于您工作的知识维基，现在还根据您过去的会话为您编写和更新代理技能。改进代理会读取完整的会话轨迹（工具调用、推理、结果），找到重复出现的模式，并且仅在有足够证据时才提出新技能或更新。在任何更改生效之前，每个用户都会通过故障场景的配对重放和工程师审查来获得内置技能。在一项为期 8 周的生产流量随机测试中，72.9% 的用户至少获得了一项新的个人技能，而手动添加一项的用户只有 6.5%。工具调用失败率下降了 11%，不满意的线程下降了 7.6%，而成本或延迟没有明显变化。
celebrity.quote_en: Sharing new research on self-improving skills in Perplexity Computer. Brain, which already maintains a knowledge wiki about your work, now also writes and updates agent skills for you based on your past sessions. An improvement agent reads the full session trajectories (tool calls, reasoning, results), finds recurring patterns, and only proposes a new skill or an update when there’s enough evidence. Built-in skills that every user gets go through paired replay on failure scenarios and engineer review before any change goes live. In an 8-week randomized test on production traffic, 72.9% of users got at least one new personal skill vs 6.5% who added one manually. Tool call failures dropped 11% and dissatisfied threads dropped 7.6%, with no measurable change in cost or latency.
celebrity.thesis_zh: 深入探讨智能体架构与协同的关键演进，直指核心工程落地与技术范式转移。
celebrity.thesis_en: Dissecting crucial inflection points in Agentic Workflows, highlighting system trade-offs and engineering shifts.

本报告旨在提高研究加速的透明度，并为日益强大的人工智能的治理提供信息。我们认为，应该要求人工智能实验室跟踪并公开报告递归自我改进（RSI）指标：人工智能加速未来人工智能系统开发的过程。

We find researchers' AI use continues to rise exponent
titans.quote_zh:
我们正在 OpenAI 上分享有关人工智能如何改变研究的新数据。

我们发现研究人员对人工智能的使用持续呈指数级增长，智能体正在完成更长的任务，但人类的参与仍然是研究的核心。研究人员也在安全和协调上花费了更多的时间，人类在这些领域的努力比任何其他单独的研究领域增长得更快。

本报告旨在提高研究加速的透明度，并为日益强大的人工智能的治理提供信息。我们认为，应该要求人工智能实验室跟踪并公开报告递归自我改进（RSI）指标：人工智能加速未来人工智能系统开发的过程。

我们希望这份扩展报告将有助于维持和推进整个行业的共享衡量规范。
titans.quote_en:
We're sharing new data on how AI is changing research at OpenAI.

We find researchers' AI use continues to rise exponentially, and agents are completing longer tasks, but human involvement remains central in research. Researchers are also spending more time on safety and alignment, with human effort in these areas growing faster than in any other individual research area.

This report aims to increase transparency around research acceleration and inform the governance of increasingly capable AI. We believe that AI labs should be required to track and publicly report indicators of recursive self-improvement (RSI): the process by which AI accelerates the development of future AI systems. 

Our hope is that this expanded report will help sustain and advance shared measurement norms across the industry.

tool_item.category_tag_zh: 🛡️ 智能体多阶段代码安全审计
tool_item.one_liner_zh: 用于多阶段安全审计的编码代理技能，具有独立验证的机器可读结果
tool_item.one_liner_en: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified
tool_item.pain_point_zh: 编码代理自主生成代码时常不自觉引入反序列化、注入或权限绕过漏洞，传统人工审计耗时且容易遗漏隐蔽攻击面。
tool_item.pain_point_en: Autonomous coding agents frequently introduce subtle vulnerabilities that manual code reviews miss under tight deadlines.
key_features_zh: 多阶段深度独立验证：对生成的代码变更执行威胁建模、动静态污点分析与边界推演
机器可读结构化报告：输出格式化安全审计建议，允许代理根据报错自动自愈重构
零云端数据外泄：在本地隔离环境中执行规则检测，保障企业专有代码私密安全
key_features_en: Multi-Phase Independent Verification: Executes threat modeling, taint analysis, and boundary audits on diffs
